question: Can an isolated strict public-transition boundary for original continuous-control causal learning be implemented and regression-qualified without importing the external simulator, consuming protected source actions, leaking latent wind/SCM state, or modifying CKAD and WSP158?
hypothesis: Given only four public state floats, a chosen 0/1 action, four next-state floats, scalar reward, and two terminal flags, an immutable canonical record can faithfully retain permissible action-consequence observations, reject privileged fields and non-finite values, and cold-serialize identically on Linux and Windows. This establishes data-boundary engineering only, not direct-weight scientific efficacy.
predecessor_evidence: WSP-158 PR1209 scientific NO_GO and exact final SHA 256cf3c240524ba009016d09ba5c8543b537411f
CKAD-18 PR1207 continues consumed synthetic witness slot accumulation; no adaptation/rewrite of CKAD
CVH-10 PR1177 lacks qualified independent virgin source-owner cohort/actor; conditional 13312-source-action cap is NOT WSP159 authority

inputs.name: CartPoleWind upstream source
inputs.source: CausalAILab/Causal-Gymnasium Apache-2.0, static read-only Git blob; ORIGINAL ENV EXECUTION PROHIBITED in this phase

inputs.name: synthetic interface validation inputs
inputs.source: literal records generated entirely inside unit tests; no upstream source reset/step/do/ctf_do

scope: Source-free interface/preflight ONLY. Not model training, not external data acquisition, not original first-use, not evidence of intelligence or architecture superiority.

frozen_design.split: No source train/valid/test cohorts used. Tests employ fabricated edge cases and deterministic record roundtrips only.
frozen_design.ordering: Preregistration sole-file commit before boundary source/tests. Engineering tests may repeat; no scientific primary is scored.
frozen_design.data_budget: 0 original environment resets, 0 steps, 0 do/ctf_do actions, 0 original/private trace rows. Fabricated negative/roundtrip vectors only.
frozen_design.compute_budget: Focused Python stdlib unittest and one mandatory complete root test regression on Linux and Windows; G29 source-atlas qualification if generated. No paid APIs or GPU.
frozen_design.capacity: Only immutable 4-float observation, two-action, 4-float next observation, scalar public reward, terminated/truncated booleans. No native memory, model, weights, or new controller in this phase.
frozen_design.evaluator: Strict schema, reject extra/private fields and nonfinite/invalid actions, canonical JSON digest roundtrip, defensive detached copying, deterministic ordering and source-absent import checks.

controls: Known-good public-only records, boundary negatives for wind/info/get_graph/ctf_do/hidden state and arbitrary keys, type-flag-mismatch, nonfinite, invalid action, overflow, mutation/copy and tamper, stable canonical hash.

classification_rules.supported: Development interface PASS only if all strict field, serialization, type and negative tests pass, original source action count=0, no source package imported, full exact-source Linux and Windows root regression PASS, and exact G29 qualification PASS. SCIENTIFIC_PASS always false.
classification_rules.mixed: Focused pass but full regression, exact-source G29 or independent OS unavailable -> ENGINEERING_UNVERIFIED without science claim.
classification_rules.negative: Any valid public-only record fails or schema allows privileged info -> ENGINEERING_NO_GO. Never change frozen test expectations to paper over it.
classification_rules.invalid: Any original external reset/step/do/ctf_do, source-first-use, accepted-ref or CKAD source mutation, missing identity, or evidence/protocol mismatch.

future_science_contract.requirement: Separately frozen and source-owner approved genuinely virgin family cohorts/action journal and fixed full-trained equal-information conventional+independent symbolic/model-based controls BEFORE any original source action, with meaningful advantage headroom; no reuse of CVH10 13312 cap as WSP159 lease.
future_science_contract.learner_input: Public tuple only; never provide latent wind, simulator source internals, counterfactual oracle, unwrapped env, graph, privileged info, or hidden labels.
future_science_contract.next_phase: Separate new freeze/engineering qualification, only after source-owner custody.

preregistration_note: Commit prereg.json alone before writing boundary implementation or tests; source-free engineering may then proceed and is not scientific first-use.
